text:
nina (prod-designer): Taking notes from the Monday usability session 4dd
Most folks read the preview "ribbons" as a progress indicator. We need a clearer visual language: lighter ribbons, explicit labels, and a tiny legend that says 'simulated distribution'.

ash (frontend): +1. My quick plan: make ribbons 5px high, add 8px vertical padding to preserve a 44px hit area, and move the percent into a right column. Also use a subtle dashed background to indicate 'this is simulated'.

maia (pm): We also saw customers get stuck when overlap warnings were subtle to the right. Can we unify validation states (inline error row + toast) and make the copy actionable? Example: "Overlap: 'Canary' overlaps 'Default'  set exclusive targets or lower priority."

leo (engineer): Implementation notes:
- Keep stable rule IDs; memoize computed percentages by id to avoid thrash.
- When switching to samples view we'll call /policies/:id/estimate; debounce 400ms and cache per-policy for 60s.
- Preserve focused row by saving focusedRuleId before layout changes and restoring afterwards.

access-bot: :warning: Accessibility scan: small label contrast fails for current accent palette. For text <14px use neutral-900 or a darker accent token to meet >=4.5:1. Ensure drag handles meet 44x44 touch target. Add aria-live for validation messages.

nina (prod-designer): Thanks. UX proposals:
- Legend: "Preview (simulated distribution)" with an info tooltip: "Distribution computed from current weights; toggle to show estimated samples (req/min)."
- Toggle: change from tiny switch to pill: "View: % | samples" so it's discoverable.
- Validation: show inline error row under affected rule with copy and a small 'Fix' button that opens the rule editor. Toast only for global errors.

ash (frontend): I'll prototype the right-column percent + pill toggle. CSS tokens I'll try:
```
--ribbon-visual-h: 5px;
--ribbon-handle-hit: 44px;
--ribbon-gap: 10px;
```
I'll also add the dashed background for the preview canvas and keep colors low-saturation to avoid progress semantics.

maia (pm): Microcopy suggestions (short + prescriptive):
- Overlap: "Rule 'Canary' overlaps 'Default'. Make targets exclusive or reduce 'Canary' priority."
- Unsupported target: "Target 'eu-west-9' unsupported. Edit or remove the target."
- Preview stale: "Preview out of date. Run preview to validate changes."
- Fix button aria-label: "Open editor to fix overlap for 'Canary'"

leo (engineer): For percent calc I'll use `Math.round((weight / total) * 100)` and store in a ref keyed by rule.id. Also ensure tooltips are accessible: aria-describedby and keyboard-focusable.

access-bot: :white_check_mark: Suggestion: add aria-live="assertive" for conflict errors and aria-describedby linking the inline error to the specific rule row. Recommend contrast >=4.5:1 for small text and visible focus outlines for keyboard reorder.

nina (prod-designer): Tiny visual detail: add a faint label above each ribbon row with the rule name in bold and the badge "Priority: High" (use full label for clarity in screenshots). Move drag handle to the far left with an 8px gap to the label.

ash (frontend): Keyboard note: Reorder with keyboard should announce the new position with `aria-live` and keep focus on the moved rule. I'll wire that up with the same focus-preserve logic.

maia (pm): Can someone own the final strings and a11y checklist? I'll own copy; engineering to validate length for tooltips and buttons.

leo (engineer): I'll pair after standup for 20m on IDs, caching, and the focus restore.

nina (prod-designer): I'll update Figma with token swaps, ribbon comps, and the pill toggle. Will paste the link here when ready. Thanks all 496
